name: Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door

needs.what: The frame rate the game was tested at is not applied (nxnative writes the engine's frame limit or steps the game by the host's vsyncs); the game runs at its own rate.
Frame holding under a frame-rate cap is not implemented.

cuts.why: frame step floor in 60 Hz vsyncs: mov w9,#2 → mov w9,#1 (the game steps by the vsyncs that passed, down to one)

address_space.note: the profile reserves heap 0.13 GB, alias 4.38 GB, stack 0.25 GB with a pool of 3.21 GB; this process has heap 0.13 GB, alias 3.44 GB, stack 0.06 GB: everything the pool lets the game commit fits, with less spare address space than nxnative gives it
